How this test works

Infantry and equipment: Infantry uses the swordsman picture, moves 2 territories, and has no special matchup bonus. Infantry and spears: Copper I, Bronze II, Iron III, Steel IV. Archers and cavalry: Copper I, Iron II, Steel III. The metal badges show equipment level; archery and horsemanship research still unlock their existing upgrades. Artillery has no equipment tiers.

Base movement per round: cavalry 4 territories, archers 3, spears 2, artillery 1. Pair your cavalry and artillery in the same territory to move both at their average speed, rounded down. Save an order for either to move both. Detach during planning to move independently; pairing or detaching clears both orders. Each keeps its own health and combat strength.

Each player edits only their own army: up to 24 regiments, any type, equipment, health and starting territory. Put both armies on the same territory for an immediate test. When both players finish setup, free editing closes and both use the normal military rules. Planning and combat wait for both players. During movement, either player can take the next step; encounters offer Attack, one-territory Retreat, or Hold. Movement orders and attack targets stay private until resolution.

Land production goes directly to Military; military meals and shortages still apply. There is no research or civilian economy management. Recruitment costs resources and trains for one round. Both players can agree to replay the original setup from Results.

Refresh on this browser to reconnect. The invitation PIN can be used once, within 24 hours. Matches remain available for seven days. Keep browser storage to retain your player seat.
